parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` are test-fixture factory methods within the `PlaylistTesting` source set of the `Playlist` package. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7142857142857143 is notable, the structural resemblance is expected: stub factories for different domain types (`Playcut` vs `Talkset`) naturally share shape without sharing semantics, and consolidating them would couple unrelated test fixtures together without production benefit.
